title: BEWARE OF USED PRODUCT
text:
BEWARE OF USED PRODUCT. we received what was clearly a used tub.

It had both, dog and human hair in it!

Also, multiple scratches on the sides.

Be aware before you buy.

product_metadata.title: Adult Foldable Massage Bathtub, 54.3 inches Foldable Children's Bathtub, Household Bathtub, Shower Room Soaking Bathtub, With Thermostatic Cover Blue (Blue, 54.3 Inch)
features: 💧【PP and TPE Materials】 Our bathtub is made of odorless PP, TPE safe materials, BPA-free, lead-free, phthalate-free, absolutely safe to the skin.
💧【Foldable and Portable】unfolded size: 138*62*22cm / 54.3x24.4x8.6 inches. The bathtub is easy to fold, does not take up space, is easy to store, and is suitable for all kinds of bathrooms.
💧【Special Design】 thermal insulation bathtub cover, which can keep the water temperature for up to one hour, continuous cycle insulation; 108° ergonomic design, let you relax in the bathtub.
💧【Enough Space】 The large space design of the foldable bathtub allows you to play freely in the water and can be used with children. Suitable for all kinds of families

💧【Massage Effect and Double Drainage System】 The bottom of the portable bathtub is equipped with bump self-service rollers, which massage the feet, allowing you to feel the comfort of bathing; the water drain is designed, and the outside can be connected with a drain pipe to make the drainage cleaner.
